high_level_description: The image depicts a decorative tile with an intricate floral design. The tile is square-shaped and features a vibrant color palette dominated by blue, yellow, and green. The background of the tile is a deep blue, which serves as a striking contrast to the bright colors of the flowers and leaves. The central motif of the tile is a symmetrical pattern that resembles a mandala or a traditional Islamic geometric design. At the heart of the design is a large, yellow, star-like shape with pointed edges.
